question: సరైన పెరుగుదల మరియు ఆరోగ్యానికి తోడ్పడటానికి క్రింది విటమిన్లలో ఏవి కోళ్ళ దాణాలో అధిక స్థాయిలో నిర్వహించబడతాయి(ఇవ్వబడతాయి)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin A, D and E**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the healthy **growth**, **reproduction**, and high **productivity** of **poultry**, it is essential to provide a nutritionally balanced diet. Among the various nutrients, **Vitamin A**, **Vitamin D**, and **Vitamin E** are maintained at significantly high levels in **poultry feed**.
 
• **Vitamin A** is crucial for maintaining the integrity of **epithelial tissues**, supporting **vision**, and ensuring healthy **bone development**. A deficiency in this vitamin can lead to **stunted growth**, high **mortality rates**, and a decrease in **egg production**.
 
• **Vitamin D** (particularly **Vitamin D3**) is indispensable for the proper **metabolism** of **calcium** and **phosphorus**. Since poultry birds are often raised in indoor environments with limited exposure to **sunlight**, supplementary **Vitamin D** is required to prevent **Rickets** and ensure **strong eggshells**.
 
• **Vitamin E** acts as a powerful **antioxidant** that protects **cell membranes** from oxidative damage. It is vital for the **immune system** and prevents neurological disorders like **Encephalomalacia** (crazy chick disease) and **Exudative Diathesis**.
 
• These three vitamins are **fat-soluble**, meaning they can be stored in the **liver** and **fatty tissues** of the bird for later use. Maintaining high levels ensures that the birds can withstand the stresses of **intensive farming** and **disease outbreaks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Composition of Poultry Feed:**
 
 
• The feed typically includes **cereals** such as **maize**, **wheat**, **millet**, and **protein sources** like **soybean meal** or **fish meal**.
 
• It is also fortified with **minerals** like **calcium** and **phosphorus**, which are essential for **skeletal strength** and **shell quality** in **layers**.
 
 
 
• **Classification of Vitamins in Poultry:**
 
 
• **Fat-Soluble Vitamins:** Includes **Vitamin A, D, E, and K**. **Vitamin K** is primarily responsible for **blood clotting** and preventing **hemorrhages**.
 
• **Water-Soluble Vitamins:** Includes **Vitamin B-complex** (B1, B2, B6, B12, Niacin, Folic Acid) and **Vitamin C**. While birds can synthesize **Vitamin C** internally, **B-complex vitamins** are often added to the feed to support **energy metabolism**.
 
 
 
• **Role of B-Complex Vitamins:**
 
 
• **Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin):** Its deficiency causes **curled-toe paralysis** in chicks.
 
• **Vitamin B12:** Essential for **embryo development** and **growth**.
 
• **Vitamin B1 (Thiamine):** Necessary for **carbohydrate metabolism**; deficiency leads to **polyneuritis**.
 
 
 
• **Nutritional Diseases in Poultry:**
 
 
• Inadequate levels of **Vitamin D** lead to **Osteomalacia** in adults and **Rickets** in young birds.
 
• Lack of **Vitamin A** causes **Xerophthalmia** and **Nutritional Roup**, characterized by discharge from the eyes and nostrils.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Age-Based Nutrition:** The requirement for **vitamins** and **proteins** varies with age. **Broilers** (meat-type) require higher **protein** and **vitamin** levels for rapid **weight gain**, whereas **Layers** (egg-type) require higher **calcium** for **egg production**.
 
• **Date and Discovery:** Most **vitamin requirements** for poultry were standardized by the **National Research Council (NRC)** in the **20th century** to optimize **food security** through **animal husbandry**.
 
• **Functions of Supplements:** Modern poultry farming utilizes **premixes** to ensure that minute quantities of **vitamins** and **trace minerals** are evenly distributed throughout the **feed**.
